# Contributing to OvertureDB

The guide is part of the documentation:
**[How to contribute](https://autogitr.github.io/Overture/overturedb/contributing)**
and the **[selection guidelines](https://autogitr.github.io/Overture/overturedb/contributing/selection-guidelines)**
every contribution follows. Their source is `docs/contributing/`, and the
maintainers' pages are in `docs/maintainers/`.
